description: This file defines data models, configurations, enums, and classes related to routing and deployment management in the litellm project. It includes classes for router configuration, model info, error handling, and routing strategies, as well as external references to other modules like completion, embedding, and llms.

classes.name: ModelConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a specific model, including model name, parameters, and throughput/rate limits.

classes.name: RouterConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for routing, including model list, Redis settings, caching, retries, and routing strategy.

classes.name: UpdateRouterConfig
classes.description: Parameters that can be updated dynamically in router settings, such as routing strategy and fallback policies.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: Metadata about a model, including IDs, timestamps, cost info, and team association.

classes.name: CredentialLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Credentials and region info for various cloud providers and services.

classes.name: GenericLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Common parameters for LiteLLM, including credentials, timeout, retries, and budget info.

classes.name: LiteLLM_Params
classes.description: Parameters required for LiteLLM completion requests, including model and credentials.

classes.name: updateLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Used to update LiteLLM parameters; model is optional.

classes.name: Deployment
classes.description: Represents a deployment configuration, including model name, parameters, and model info.

classes.name: RouterErrors
classes.description: Enum for common router error messages.

classes.name: AllowedFailsPolicy
classes.description: Policy for allowed failure counts per exception type before cooldown.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: Policy for retry counts per exception type.

classes.name: AlertingConfig
classes.description: Configuration for alerting via webhook, including threshold for slow responses.

classes.name: ModelGroupInfo
classes.description: Metadata about a group of models, including capabilities and costs.

classes.name: AssistantsTypedDict
classes.description: TypedDict for assistant configurations with provider and parameters.

classes.name: SearchToolLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Parameters for search tools, including provider and API keys.

classes.name: SearchToolTypedDict
classes.description: Configuration for a search tool, including name and parameters.

classes.name: GuardrailLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Parameters for guardrails, including guardrail name and mode.

classes.name: GuardrailTypedDict
classes.description: Configuration for guardrails, including callback and ID.

classes.name: FineTuningConfig
classes.description: Configuration for fine-tuning, specifying provider.

classes.name: CustomRoutingStrategyBase
classes.description: Base class for custom routing strategies with async deployment retrieval.

classes.name: RouterGeneralSettings
classes.description: General settings for the router, including async-only mode and pass-through.

classes.name: RouterRateLimitErrorBasic
classes.description: Basic rate limit error class.

classes.name: RouterRateLimitError
classes.description: Detailed rate limit error with cooldown info.

classes.name: RouterModelGroupAliasItem
classes.description: TypedDict for model group alias items.

classes.name: RoutingStrategy
classes.description: Enum for different routing strategies.

classes.name: RouterCacheEnum
classes.description: Enum for cache key patterns.

classes.name: GenericBudgetWindowDetails
classes.description: Details about a provider's budget window.

classes.name: LiteLLM_RouterFileObject
classes.description: TypedDict for tracking litellm params hash and associated file object.

classes.name: MockRouterTestingParams
classes.description: Dataclass for mock testing parameters with class method for initialization.

classes.name: ModelGroupSettings
classes.description: Settings related to model groups, such as headers to forward.

classes.name: PreRoutingHookResponse
classes.description: Response object from pre-routing hook, including model and messages.

methods.name: async_get_available_deployment
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an available deployment based on model and context.

methods.name: get_available_deployment
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves an available deployment based on model and context.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Various class initializers, e.g., for ModelInfo, GenericLiteLLMParams, LiteLLM_Params, Deployment, MockRouterTestingParams.

methods.name: __contains__
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets attribute value with default fallback.
